answer: OBD-II driving-behavior signature with acceleration profile is my pick. A vehicle's OBD-II dongle signs a week of acceleration and braking profiles bound to the identity. A farm needs one driven vehicle per copy, and synthetic profiles fail the physics consistency check. Think of the lagoon as a toll that cannot be shared: the anchor lands on each identity separately, so the ledge of a thousand-copy farm is a thousand tolls against one payout.
